subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to share the itinerary for our upcoming trip to Paris. We have booked flights on June 15th and return on June 22nd. The hotel reservation is confirmed at Hotel Riviera for the entire stay. Additionally, I have booked a guided tour of the Louvre Museum on June 17th. Please let me know if you have any preferences or questions. Looking forward to our trip! Best regards, [Your Name]
